description: Great to have my friend, Noelle Donovan, member of the Westford Conservation Commission and candidate for Select Board on my podcast! We talked about growing up in Westford and her passion for representing all voices in town. Take a listen to learn more about Noelle!
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Jim Arciero
title: Noelle Donovan — State Rep. James Arciero
